text: List notes: free-text textarea in list properties

Done in fd5ff19, all three platforms (server full, Android full, web
basic-per-scope but with real test coverage).

Server: notes/notes_ts/notes_by columns, migration via T-57's mechanism,
5000-char validation, 5 new engine tests.

Android: Room migration 2->3, ListsRepo.setNotes(), ListPropsScreen Notes
section (multiline field + Save), full sync merge/push wiring. Repo +
ViewModel + Compose UI + DTO tests.

Web: ListPropsPage Notes textarea/save form (blank -> null, matching
Android), 3 tests.

Verification: server 173+ pytest, Android 4 targeted test classes + full
compile + lintDebug (all green), web 47 vitest + tsc -p tsconfig.app.json
+ oxlint (all green). Real find along the way: bare `npx tsc --noEmit`
silently checks zero files in this repo — must use -p tsconfig.app.json
(saved as a memory gotcha, applies to every future web verification).
